premises.text: Personalization can significantly improve user engagement and conversion rates
premises.evidence_span: we had a 241% improvement in click-through rate, a 150% improvement in engagement. In this case, those were bids for them. And a 102% improvement in actual on-revenue new conversion.

premises.text: Current personalization methods are often ineffective due to overwhelming data
premises.evidence_span: Everyone is overwhelmed, marketers, product managers, absolutely overwhelmed with data.

premises.text: Real-time personalization can be achieved by analyzing all user data dynamically
premises.evidence_span: we look at all the information about all users on the site combined with all content in kind of a dynamically changing soup of information with you at the center.

premises.text: LiftIgniter can personalize for new users effectively, even without historical data
premises.evidence_span: personalize in real time for every single user, even brand new cold start users.

premises.text: Integration of LiftIgniter's platform is quick and does not require extensive time
premises.evidence_span: it took minutes to integrate, not months.

premises.text: The platform processes user actions in real-time to provide immediate responses
premises.evidence_span: every time that a user takes an action, it's processed by our algorithms, it's returned to the site, all in 125 millisecond round trip.

premises.text: LiftIgniter's pricing model is usage-based, making it easy for customers to adopt
premises.evidence_span: our pricing is usage-based, which means that it's very easy for our customers to add new items and new parts of the site that they want to start personalizing.

value.text: Users receive personalized content that enhances their engagement and conversion
value.evidence_span: we had a 241% improvement in click-through rate, a 150% improvement in engagement.

notes: Customer count, revenue metrics, and growth rates are excluded as traction.
